task.description: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) for REQ-165. ELIXIR-DEV already wrote 9 tests in test/letflow/engine/wasm/plugin_handler_test.exs covering AC3-AC8, and both SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER passed the implementation cleanly (REVIEWER independently rebuilt the whole Rust toolchain from scratch to verify). Your job: actively find real coverage gaps using MUTATION TESTING. Specific mutation targets: (1) remove the GenServer.stop/1 cleanup call on the success path of run_guest/2, confirm a test catches the leaked process (or if no test catches it, this is a real gap -- add one, e.g. asserting no orphaned Wasmex GenServer remains after a call); (2) change the executed_in_pid field to hardcode the caller's own self() instead of the handler's actual self(), confirm the process-boundary test (AC4) catches it; (3) change the hang fixture's outer PluginInterface.invoke timeout comparison or the error message pattern, confirm AC5's test catches a wrong error message; (4) mutate the moduledoc's residual-risk-disclosure string, confirm AC8's content-check test catches it; (5) in lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check_toolchain.ex, mutate running_rust_version/0 to swallow a System.cmd/2 error silently instead of returning :not_found, confirm a test (existing or new) catches the F9 regression.
acceptance_criteria: Mutation-test the GenServer.stop/1 cleanup path: remove it on success, confirm existing tests catch a leaked process or add a test that does.
Mutation-test AC4's process-boundary proof: hardcode the wrong pid, confirm the test catches it.
Mutation-test AC5's hang/timeout error message: mutate it, confirm a test catches the change.
Mutation-test AC8's residual-risk moduledoc disclosure: mutate the string, confirm a test catches it.
Mutation-test letflow.check_toolchain.ex's new F9 failure mode (rustc not found): confirm a real test exercises this path, not just the happy path where rustc IS found.
Confirm every one of REQ-165's 9 real acceptance criteria (docs/requirements.yaml) has at least one test that would fail if that specific behavior regressed -- verified by actually breaking it.
Update test/specs/REQ-165.md with the mutation-testing findings table.
